C1066.title: Dandong Zhen'an Police Crack a Case of Sabotaging Enterprise Communication Facilities
C1066.summary: In July 2023, mobile broadband lines serving over 40 households in a residential building on Dongping Street, Zhen'an District, Dandong City, Liaoning Province were suddenly disrupted. On-site investigation by staff confirmed the broadband lines had been deliberately damaged.
